codes.description: A name was used that has no visible binding in the current scope. No guess is made about intent.
codes.title: Unknown binding

codes.description: A value of one type was used where a different, incompatible type was required.
codes.title: Type mismatch

codes.description: A value was used after ownership moved away. The previous owner no longer holds it.
codes.title: Use after move

codes.description: An immutable binding was reassigned. Immutable means assigned once.
codes.title: Immutable reassignment

codes.description: A call target was invoked with the wrong shape: unknown callee, arity mismatch, or bad argument kind.
codes.title: Invalid call

codes.description: An index fell outside the container bounds at compile time or at runtime.
codes.title: Index out of bounds

codes.description: A numeric literal or word could not be parsed as the requested numeric type.
codes.title: Numeric parse failure

codes.description: A numeric value or computation exceeded the representable range of its type.
codes.title: Numeric overflow

codes.description: A resource request failed: allocation refused, capacity exhausted, or handle unavailable.
codes.title: Allocation failure

codes.description: The requested target, backend, or ABI is not supported by this compiler build.
codes.title: Unsupported target

stability: Codes E0001-E0010 are stable. A code is never renamed, renumbered, or repurposed. New conditions get new codes; retired conditions keep their entry marked retired, never deleted.
